claims.claim_text_en: Reduce economy-wide GHG emissions by 15% below 1990 by 2035 unconditionally, and by up to 25% subject to international support.

brief.core_idea_en: NDC 3.0 sets one economy-wide target: a 15% reduction below 1990 levels by 2035 without conditions, rising to up to 25% with international support. No sector pathway or interim milestone appears in the pages read.

responses.text_en: Economy-wide GHG reduction target for 2035 against a 1990 base, with an unconditional and a conditional variant (NDC 3.0, p. 12).

numbers.text_en: 15% below 1990 by 2035, unconditional; up to 25% below 1990 by 2035, subject to international support (NDC 3.0, p. 12).

gaps.text_en: The 1990 emissions level is not stated on the page, so the absolute target cannot be derived.
